import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
weight = {
    "Alpha":   68,
    "Beta":    34,
    "Gamma":   57,
    "Delta":   43,
    "Epsilon": 48,
    "Zeta":    64,
    "Eta":     68,
    "Theta":   56,
    "Iota":    60,
    "Kappa":   54,
    "Lambda":  68,
    "Mu":      67,
    "Nu":      44,
    "Xi":      31,
}
capacity = 100                     # kg per truck
P = list(weight.keys())           # list of package names
T_max = 14                         # an upper bound on the number of trucks

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Truck_Packing", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# x[p,t] = 1 if package p is placed on truck t
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    ((p, t) for p in P for t in range(T_max)),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat="Binary",
)

# y[t] = 1 if truck t is used
y = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "y",
    (t for t in range(T_max)),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat="Binary",
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective (R4)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(y[t] for t in range(T_max)), "R4_min_trucks"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraints
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: each package assigned to exactly one truck
for p in P:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[p, t] for t in range(T_max)) == 1,
        f"R1_{p}",
    )

# R2: a truck can only be used if at least one package is assigned to it
for p in P:
    for t in range(T_max):
        model += (
            x[p, t] <= y[t],
            f"R2_{p}_{t}",
        )

# R3: weight on any truck cannot exceed its capacity
for t in range(T_max):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(weight[p] * x[p, t] for p in P) <= capacity * y[t],
        f"R3_{t}",
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Minimum number of trucks used: {int(pulp.value(model.objective))}\n")

# Show which packages go on which used truck
for t in range(T_max):
    if pulp.value(y[t]) > 0.5:  # truck is used
        assigned = [p for p in P if pulp.value(x[p, t]) > 0.5]
        total_w = sum(weight[p] for p in assigned)
        print(f"Truck {t+1} (load {total_w} kg): {', '.join(assigned)}")

# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
components = [
    ("Alpha",   55),
    ("Beta",    66),

    ("Kappa",   48),
    ("Lambda",  39),
    ("Mu",      53),
    ("Nu",      36),
    ("Xi",      38),
    ("Omicron", 33),
    ("Pi",      38),
    ("Rho",     67),
    ("Sigma",   65),
    ("Tau",     42),
    ("Upsilon", 30),
    ("Phi",     32),
    ("Chi",     55)
]

num_items   = 22                     # total number of components
max_crates  = 22                     # upper bound on crates (one per component)
crate_capacity = 100                # maximum mass a crate can hold

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("transport_crate_plan", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# x[i,k] = 1 if component i is placed in crate k, else 0
x = {}
for i in range(num_items):
    for k in range(max_crates):
        var_name = f"x_{i}_{k}"
        x[(i, k)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")

# y[k] = 1 if crate k is used, else 0
y = {}
for k in range(max_crates):
    var_name = f"y_{k}"
    y[k] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimise the number of used crates
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(y[k] for k in range(max_crates)), "objective_min_crates"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: each component must be assigned to exactly one crate
for i in range(num_items):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(i, k)] for k in range(max_crates)) == 1,
        f"R1_assign_{i}"
    )

# R2: total mass in any crate cannot exceed its capacity
for k in range(max_crates):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(components[i][1] * x[(i, k)] for i in range(num_items))
        <= crate_capacity * y[k],
        f"R2_capacity_{k}"
    )

# R3: a crate is considered used only if at least one component is placed in it
for i in range(num_items):
    for k in range(max_crates):
        model += (
            x[(i, k)] <= y[k],
            f"R3_link_{i}_{k}"
        )

# R4: all decision variables are binary – already enforced by variable definitions

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
status = pulp.LpStatus[model.status]
print(f"Solution status: {status}")

if status == "Optimal":
    used_crates = [k for k in range(max_crates) if pulp.value(y[k]) > 0.5]
    print(f"Number of crates used: {len(used_crates)}")
    for k in used_crates:
        assigned = [components[i][0] for i in range(num_items) if pulp.value(x[(i, k)]) > 0.5]
        total_mass = sum(components[i][1] for i in range(num_items) if pulp.value(x[(i, k)]) > 0.5)
        print(f" Crate {k+1}: components = {assigned}, total mass = {total_mass}")
else:
    print("No optimal solution found.")

import pulp

# -----------------------------
# Data
# -----------------------------
volume = [
    44, 43, 34, 57, 52, 64, 34, 40, 41, 70,
    69, 44, 65, 35, 48, 62, 54, 33, 70, 52,
    43, 59, 67, 66, 42, 59, 62, 36, 58, 42,
    52, 68, 50, 51, 68, 69
]  # cubic feet, index 0..35

truck_capacity = 100  # cubic feet
num_packages = len(volume)          # 36
max_trucks   = num_packages          # upper bound on trucks needed

# -----------------------------
# Model
# -----------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("plan", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    (range(num_packages), range(max_trucks)),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

y = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "y",
    range(max_trucks),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

# Objective: minimize number of trucks used
model += pulp.lpSum(y[t] for t in range(max_trucks)), "Minimize_trucks"

# -----------------------------
# Requirements as named constraints
# -----------------------------

# R1: each package assigned to exactly one truck
for p in range(num_packages):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[p][t] for t in range(max_trucks)) == 1,
        f"R1_package_{p}",
    )

# R2: truck capacity cannot be exceeded
for t in range(max_trucks):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(volume[p] * x[p][t] for p in range(num_packages))
        <= truck_capacity * y[t],
        f"R2_capacity_{t}",
    )

# R3: a truck is considered used if any package is assigned to it
# (linking constraint)
for p in range(num_packages):
    for t in range(max_trucks):
        model += (
            y[t] >= x[p][t],
            f"R3_link_{p}_{t}",
        )

# -----------------------------
# Solve
# -----------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# -----------------------------
# Output
# -----------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
used_trucks = [t for t in range(max_trucks) if pulp.value(y[t]) > 0.5]
print(f"Number of trucks used: {len(used_trucks)}")

# Show assignment of packages to trucks
for t in used_trucks:
    assigned = [p + 1 for p in range(num_packages) if pulp.value(x[p][t]) > 0.5]  # +1 for readability
    total_vol = sum(volume[p - 1] for p in assigned)
    print(f"Truck {t + 1}: Packages {assigned}, Total volume = {total_vol} / {truck_capacity}")

# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("crate_allocation", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# x[i,j] = 1 if box i is placed in crate j
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    (range(num_boxes), range(max_crates)),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

y = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "y",
    range(max_crates),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

        pulp.lpSum(x[i][j] for j in range(max_crates)) == 1,

        pulp.lpSum(weights[boxes[i]] * x[i][j] for i in range(num_boxes))

T = 20
initial_stock = 72
capacity = 72
demand = [
    29, 15, 33, 19, 38, 11, 34, 51, 38, 13,
    50, 59, 59, 28, 42, 49, 59, 37, 39, 49
]  # thousand liters, weeks 1..20
order_min = 16
order_max = 32
cost_order = 1      # per thousand liters
cost_holding = 2    # per thousand liters carried to next week
cost_shortage = 7   # per thousand liters of unmet demand

# -----------------------------
# Model
# -----------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Fuel_Additive_Procurement", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
order = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("order", range(1, T + 1), lowBound=0, cat='Continuous')
stock = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("stock", range(1, T + 1), lowBound=0, cat='Continuous')
shortage = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("shortage", range(1, T + 1), lowBound=0, cat='Continuous')

# -----------------------------
# Requirements as constraints
# -----------------------------

# R1: Order quantity bounds
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    model += order[t] >= order_min, f"R1_order_min_{t}"
    model += order[t] <= order_max, f"R1_order_max_{t}"

# R2: Inventory capacity bounds (non‑negativity already enforced by lowBound)
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    model += stock[t] <= capacity, f"R2_capacity_{t}"

# R3: Shortage non‑negativity (already enforced, but named as required)
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    model += shortage[t] >= 0, f"R3_nonneg_{t}"

# R6: Shortage cannot exceed demand
for t in range(1, T + 1):
    model += shortage[t] <= demand[t - 1], f"R6_limit_{t}"

# R4: Inventory balance with 1‑week lead time
# Week 1 (no arrival)
model += (
    stock[1] == initial_stock - (demand[0] - shortage[1]),
    "R4_balance_1"
)

# Weeks 2..T

        stock[t] == stock[t - 1] + order[t - 1] - (demand[t - 1] - shortage[t]),
        f"R4_balance_{t}"

    cost_order * order[t] +
    cost_holding * stock[t] +
    cost_shortage * shortage[t]
    for t in range(1, T + 1)
)
model += total_cost, "Total_Cost"

# -----------------------------
# Solve
# -----------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# -----------------------------
# Output results
# -----------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Total cost: {pulp.value(model.objective):.2f}")

print("\nWeek | Order | Stock End | Shortage")

    sh = pulp.value(shortage[t])

), "TotalCost"

# -----------------------------
T = range(1, 21)                     # planning horizon
initial_inventory = 97.0             # thousand cubic feet
lead_time = 1                        # days (used in R6)
order_min = 18.0
order_max = 59.0
capacity = 97.0
procurement_cost = 1.0               # monetary unit per thousand cf
storage_cost = 1.0                   # monetary unit per thousand cf per day
shortage_penalty = 10.0              # monetary units per thousand cf
consumption = {
    1: 53, 2: 47, 3: 56, 4: 59, 5: 43,
    6: 20, 7: 41, 8: 51, 9: 50, 10: 25,
    11: 10, 12: 24, 13: 19, 14: 55, 15: 48,
    16: 53, 17: 59, 18: 19, 19: 50, 20: 19
}

# -----------------------------
# Model
# -----------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Fuel_Procurement_and_Storage", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
order = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("order", T, lowBound=0, cat='Continuous')
inventory = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("inventory", T, lowBound=0, cat='Continuous')
shortage = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("shortage", T, lowBound=0, cat='Continuous')
received = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("received", T, lowBound=0, cat='Continuous')

# -----------------------------
# Requirements as constraints
# -----------------------------

# R1: order bounds
for t in T:
    model += order[t] >= order_min, f"R1_min_{t}"
    model += order[t] <= order_max, f"R1_max_{t}"

# R2: inventory capacity
for t in T:
    model += inventory[t] <= capacity, f"R2_capacity_{t}"

# R3: inventory non‑negative (already enforced by lowBound, but named constraint required)
for t in T:
    model += inventory[t] >= 0, f"R3_nonneg_{t}"

# R4: shortage bounds
for t in T:
    model += shortage[t] >= 0, f"R4_nonneg_{t}"
    model += shortage[t] <= consumption[t], f"R4_ub_{t}"

# R5: initial inventory (inventory[0] = 97)
# Handled directly in balance equations; no separate variable needed.

# R6: received[t] = order[t-1] (lead time 1 day)
model += received[1] == 0, "R6_received_1"
for t in T:
    if t >= 2:
        model += received[t] == order[t-1], f"R6_received_{t}"

# R7: inventory balance
for t in T:
    prev_inv = initial_inventory if t == 1 else inventory[t-1]
    model += (
        inventory[t]
        == prev_inv + received[t] - consumption[t] + shortage[t]
    ), f"R7_balance_{t}"

# R8: shortage definition (redundant but required)
for t in T:
    prev_inv = initial_inventory if t == 1 else inventory[t-1]
    model += (

        == consumption[t] - (prev_inv + received[t] - inventory[t])
    ), f"R8_shortage_def_{t}"

# -----------------------------

    procurement_cost * order[t]
    + storage_cost * (initial_inventory if t == 1 else inventory[t-1])
    + shortage_penalty * shortage[t]
    for t in T
)
model += total_cost, "R9_total_cost"

# -----------------------------
# Solve
# -----------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

}

    for k in range(len(routes[s])):

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
proc_time = {}   # processing time of each operation
hub_of = {}      # hub of each operation
all_ops = []     # list of all operation identifiers (s,k)

for s in shipments:
    for k, (hub, p) in enumerate(routes[s], start=1):
        proc_time[(s, k)] = p
        hub_of[(s, k)] = hub
        all_ops.append((s, k))

            start[(s, k + 1)] >= start[(s, k)] + proc_time[(s, k)],
            f"R1_seq_{s}_{k}_to_{k+1}",

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    ("R1", 1): "C3", ("R1", 2): "C2", ("R1", 3): "C1", ("R1", 4): "C4",
    ("R2", 1): "C2", ("R2", 2): "C1", ("R2", 3): "C4", ("R2", 4): "C3",

    ("R4", 1): "C3", ("R4", 2): "C2", ("R4", 3): "C4", ("R4", 4): "C1",
}

centers = ["C1", "C2", "C3", "C4"]
num_stages = 4

# Big‑M (larger than any possible makespan)
M = 100

# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

for r in routes:
    for k in range(1, num_stages + 1):
        var_name = f"S_{r}_{k}"
        S[(r, k)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# Binary ordering variables for each unordered pair of stages that share a center
Y = {}   # key: (i, j, c) where i < j (lexicographically)
stage_list = []   # list of (r, k) tuples for easier indexing
for r in routes:
    for k in range(1, num_stages + 1):
        stage_list.append((r, k))

# Build a mapping from center to the stages that occur there
center_to_stages = {c: [] for c in centers}
for (r, k) in stage_list:
    c = center[(r, k)]
    center_to_stages[c].append((r, k))

# Create binary variables for each unordered pair at the same center
for c in centers:
    stages_at_c = center_to_stages[c]
    for i in range(len(stages_at_c)):

            var_name = f"Y_{ri}_{ki}_{rj}_{kj}_{c}"
            Y[(ri, ki, rj, kj, c)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")

# Constraints
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: start times must be non‑negative (already enforced by lowBound, but we name them)

    model += var >= 0, f"R1_nonneg_{r}_{k}"

        model += (
            S[(r, k + 1)] >= S[(r, k)] + dur[(r, k)],
            f"R2_prec_{r}_{k}"

    stages_at_c = center_to_stages[c]

    )

# Solve

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Scheduling model for 9 trucks and 9 distribution centers.
Minimises the makespan (C_max) using PuLP and the HiGHS solver.
"""

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
trucks = ["T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6", "T7", "T8", "T9"]
num_ops = 9
bigM = 100000

# unloading times (indexed from 1 to 9 for readability)
unloading_time = {
    "T1": [0, 8, 5, 4, 9, 10, 4, 2, 8, 4],
    "T2": [0, 2, 8, 7, 8, 6, 10, 5, 8, 3],
    "T3": [0, 2, 7, 4, 5, 2, 7, 10, 5, 9],
    "T4": [0, 2, 2, 9, 10, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9],
    "T5": [0, 6, 3, 2, 9, 6, 10, 4, 2, 9],
    "T6": [0, 1, 7, 5, 9, 6, 4, 10, 6, 5],
    "T7": [0, 5, 8, 1, 6, 6, 4, 6, 6, 6],
    "T8": [0, 6, 1, 7, 3, 2, 3, 1, 9, 5],
    "T9": [0, 5, 1, 2, 8, 5, 7, 4, 3, 8],
}

# centre sequence (indexed from 1 to 9)
center_seq = {
    "T1": [0, "D9", "D6", "D2", "D7", "D1", "D3", "D4", "D8", "D5"],
    "T2": [0, "D6", "D7", "D3", "D8", "D1", "D2", "D4", "D9", "D5"],
    "T3": [0, "D5", "D1", "D4", "D6", "D8", "D7", "D3", "D9", "D2"],
    "T4": [0, "D1", "D9", "D4", "D6", "D7", "D3", "D8", "D5", "D2"],
    "T5": [0, "D4", "D7", "D8", "D2", "D5", "D6", "D9", "D1", "D3"],
    "T6": [0, "D2", "D8", "D5", "D7", "D4", "D3", "D9", "D1", "D6"],
    "T7": [0, "D2", "D8", "D7", "D9", "D1", "D5", "D6", "D3", "D4"],
    "T8": [0, "D7", "D4", "D1", "D8", "D5", "D3", "D2", "D9", "D6"],
    "T9": [0, "D4", "D6", "D2", "D5", "D1", "D7", "D3", "D9", "D8"],
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Truck_Unloading_Schedule", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
S = {}  # start times
for t in trucks:
    for k in range(1, num_ops + 1):
        var_name = f"S_{t}_{k}"
        S[(t, k)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

C_max = pulp.LpVariable("C_max", lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# Binary ordering variables Y for each unordered pair of operations that share a centre
Y = {}
for t1 in trucks:
    for k1 in range(1, num_ops + 1):
        centre1 = center_seq[t1][k1]
        for t2 in trucks:
            for k2 in range(1, num_ops + 1):
                # consider only distinct operations and enforce a canonical ordering to avoid duplicates
                if (t1, k1) >= (t2, k2):
                    continue
                if centre1 != center_seq[t2][k2]:
                    continue
                var_name = f"Y_{t1}_{k1}_{t2}_{k2}"
                Y[(t1, k1, t2, k2)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: precedence within each truck
for t in trucks:
    for k in range(1, num_ops):
        model += (
            S[(t, k + 1)] >= S[(t, k)] + unloading_time[t][k],
            f"R1_precedence_{t}_{k}",
        )

# R2: mutual exclusion at each centre using Y variables
for (t1, k1, t2, k2), y_var in Y.items():
    p1 = unloading_time[t1][k1]
    p2 = unloading_time[t2][k2]

    # If y = 1 then (t1,k1) before (t2,k2)
    model += (
        S[(t2, k2)] >= S[(t1, k1)] + p1 - bigM * (1 - y_var),
        f"R2_before_{t1}_{k1}_{t2}_{k2}",
    )
    # If y = 0 then (t2,k2) before (t1,k1)
    model += (
        S[(t1, k1)] >= S[(t2, k2)] + p2 - bigM * y_var,
        f"R2_after_{t1}_{k1}_{t2}_{k2}",
    )

# R3: non‑negative start times (already enforced by lowBound, but we add named constraints)
for t in trucks:
    for k in range(1, num_ops + 1):
        model += S[(t, k)] >= 0, f"R3_nonneg_{t}_{k}"

# R4: makespan definition
for t in trucks:
    model += (
        C_max >= S[(t, num_ops)] + unloading_time[t][num_ops],
        f"R4_makespan_{t}",
    )

# R5 is satisfied by construction of Y (only created for shared centres)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += C_max, "Minimize_makespan"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Optimal makespan (C_max): {pulp.value(C_max)}\n")

print("Start times (S[t,k]):")
for t in trucks:
    for k in range(1, num_ops + 1):
        print(f"  {t} operation {k} (center {center_seq[t][k]}): {pulp.value(S[(t,k)])}")

# Optional: show ordering decisions for a few centre conflicts
print("\nSample ordering decisions (Y variables):")
count = 0
for key, var in Y.items():
    if pulp.value(var) > 0.5:
        t1, k1, t2, k2 = key
        print(f"  {t1} op {k1} before {t2} op {k2} at centre {center_seq[t1][k1]}")
        count += 1
        if count >= 10:
            break

# Data
# -------------------------
# Outlet coefficients and flows
coeff = {"A": 0.986, "B": 2.241, "C": 1.736, "D": 1.11}
flow = {"A": 214.015, "B": 51.386, "C": 237.741, "D": 242.512}

# Technology reduction fractions
reduction = {"1": 0.82, "2": 0.56, "3": 0.76, "4": 0.13}

# Cost per m3 for each outlet‑technology pair
cost = {
    ("A", "1"): 108.412, ("A", "2"): 19.541, ("A", "3"): 57.348, ("A", "4"): 171.184,
    ("B", "1"): 96.728,  ("B", "2"): 162.269, ("B", "3"): 136.84, ("B", "4"): 197.7,
    ("C", "1"): 123.136, ("C", "2"): 190.508, ("C", "3"): 179.371, ("C", "4"): 126.404,
    ("D", "1"): 146.662, ("D", "2"): 105.908, ("D", "3"): 167.808, ("D", "4"): 114.096,
}

# Required overall reduction fraction
P = 0.649

# -------------------------
# Model
# -------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Water_Treatment_Plan", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: fraction of flow at outlet i treated with technology j
x = {}
for outlet in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]:
    for tech in ["1", "2", "3", "4"]:
        var_name = f"x_{outlet}{tech}"
        x[(outlet, tech)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# -------------------------
# Objective: minimise total cost
# -------------------------
model += (
    pulp.lpSum(
        cost[(outlet, tech)] * flow[outlet] * x[(outlet, tech)]
        for outlet in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]
        for tech in ["1", "2", "3", "4"]
    ),
    "Total_Cost",
)

# -------------------------
# Requirement R1: sum of fractions at each outlet ≤ 1
# -------------------------
for outlet in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(outlet, tech)] for tech in ["1", "2", "3", "4"]) <= 1,
        f"R1_{outlet}",
    )

# -------------------------
# Requirement R2: all fractions ≥ 0 (explicitly named)
# -------------------------
for outlet in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]:
    for tech in ["1", "2", "3", "4"]:
        model += (
            x[(outlet, tech)] >= 0,
            f"R2_{outlet}{tech}",
        )

# -------------------------
# Requirement R4: each fraction ≤ 1 (explicitly named)
# -------------------------
for outlet in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]:
    for tech in ["1", "2", "3", "4"]:
        model += (
            x[(outlet, tech)] <= 1,
            f"R4_{outlet}{tech}",
        )

# -------------------------
# Requirement R3: total TDS after treatment ≤ (1‑P) * baseline
# -------------------------
# Baseline total TDS discharge
baseline = sum(coeff[o] * flow[o] for o in ["A", "B", "C", "D"])

# Right‑hand side (maximum allowed after‑treatment discharge)
rhs = (1 - P) * baseline

# Left‑hand side: baseline minus the amount removed by treatment
removed = pulp.lpSum(
    coeff[outlet] * flow[outlet] * reduction[tech] * x[(outlet, tech)]
    for outlet in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]
    for tech in ["1", "2", "3", "4"]
)

# Constraint: baseline - removed ≤ rhs   ⇔   removed ≥ baseline - rhs
model += (
    removed >= baseline - rhs,
    "R3_TDS",
)

# -------------------------
# Solve
# -------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# -------------------------
# Output
# -------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Total cost = ${pulp.value(model.objective):.2f}\n")

for outlet in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]:
    for tech in ["1", "2", "3", "4"]:
        var = x[(outlet, tech)]
        if var.varValue is not None and var.varValue > 1e-6:
            print(f"{var.name} = {var.varValue:.4f}")

# Verify the TDS constraint
total_removed = sum(
    coeff[o] * flow[o] * reduction[t] * x[(o, t)].varValue
    for o in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]
    for t in ["1", "2", "3", "4"]
)
total_after = baseline - total_removed
print(f"\nBaseline TDS discharge = {baseline:.4f}")
print(f"TDS after treatment   = {total_after:.4f} (must be ≤ {rhs:.4f})")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

}

    "Line1": {"A": 63.034, "B": 131.882, "C": 85.939, "D": 196.418},
    "Line2": {"A": 111.881, "B": 188.455, "C": 31.915, "D": 194.376},
    "Line3": {"A": 43.928, "B": 192.882, "C": 60.439, "D": 30.596},
    "Line4": {"A": 92.567, "B": 148.424, "C": 69.599, "D": 125.18},
}

P = 0.456  # required fraction of initial total defects to be reduced

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Quality_Enhancement_Plan", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: x[l,p] = 1 if protocol p is applied to line l, else 0
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    ((l, p) for l in lines for p in protocols),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R1: each x[l,p] must be binary (0 or 1)
# (binary type already enforces this, but we also add explicit bounds)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for l in lines:
    for p in protocols:
        model += x[(l, p)] >= 0, f"R1_{l}_{p}_lb"
        model += x[(l, p)] <= 1, f"R1_{l}_{p}_ub"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirement R3: combined reduction rate for any line cannot exceed 1
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for l in lines:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(reduction_rate[p] * x[(l, p)] for p in protocols) <= 1,
        f"R3_{l}_max_reduction",
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    defect_coeff[l] * output[l] for l in lines
)

    defect_coeff[l]
    * output[l]
    * pulp.lpSum(reduction_rate[p] * x[(l, p)] for p in protocols)
    for l in lines
)

    total_reduction >= P * initial_total_defects,
    "R2_total_reduction",
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
units = ["A", "B", "C", "D"]
tech = ["Alpha", "Beta", "Gamma", "Delta"]

# discharge coefficient for each unit
coeff = {
    "A": 2.179,
    "B": 1.25,
    "C": 1.29,
    "D": 2.38,
}

# output volume for each unit
volume = {
    "A": 68.136,
    "B": 164.571,
    "C": 299.614,
    "D": 299.024,
}

# reduction fraction achieved by each technology
reduction = {
    "Alpha": 0.84,
    "Beta": 0.73,
    "Gamma": 0.69,
    "Delta": 0.15,
}

# implementation cost per unit of output (cost matrix)
cost = {
    ("A", "Alpha"): 177.364,
    ("A", "Beta"): 177.061,
    ("A", "Gamma"): 80.21,
    ("A", "Delta"): 39.972,
    ("B", "Alpha"): 168.412,
    ("B", "Beta"): 143.673,
    ("B", "Gamma"): 126.219,
    ("B", "Delta"): 197.574,
    ("C", "Alpha"): 134.256,
    ("C", "Beta"): 11.486,
    ("C", "Gamma"): 165.25,
    ("C", "Delta"): 66.882,
    ("D", "Alpha"): 136.044,
    ("D", "Beta"): 188.397,
    ("D", "Gamma"): 35.515,
    ("D", "Delta"): 31.931,
}

# required overall reduction fraction
P = 0.254

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Effluent_Reduction_Plan", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables:
#   f[(i,t)] = fraction of unit i's output treated with technology t
#   u[i]    = fraction of unit i's output left untreated
f = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("frac", [(i, t) for i in units for t in tech],
                          lowBound=0, upBound=1, cat="Continuous")
u = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("untreated", units, lowBound=0, upBound=1, cat="Continuous")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimise total implementation cost
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(
    f[(i, t)] * volume[i] * cost[(i, t)] for i in units for t in tech
), "Total_Cost"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraints
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: overall reduction must be at least P of the baseline discharge
baseline_discharge = sum(coeff[i] * volume[i] for i in units)
model += (
    pulp.lpSum(
        f[(i, t)] * volume[i] * coeff[i] * reduction[t]
        for i in units for t in tech
    )
    >= P * baseline_discharge
), "R1_Minimum_Reduction"

# R2_i: for each unit, fractions of treated + untreated must sum to 1
for i in units:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(f[(i, t)] for t in tech) + u[i] == 1
    ), f"R2_{i}_Allocation"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Total cost: {pulp.value(model.objective):.4f}")

print("\nTreatment fractions per unit:")
for i in units:
    print(f" Unit {i}:")
    for t in tech:
        val = f[(i, t)].value()
        if val is not None and val > 1e-6:
            print(f"   {t}: {val:.4f}")
    untreated_val = u[i].value()
    if untreated_val is not None and untreated_val > 1e-6:
        print(f"   Untreated: {untreated_val:.4f}")

# Verify reduction
total_reduction = sum(
    f[(i, t)].value() * volume[i] * coeff[i] * reduction[t]
    for i in units for t in tech
)
print(f"\nBaseline discharge: {baseline_discharge:.4f}")
print(f"Achieved reduction: {total_reduction:.4f}")
print(f"Required reduction (P*baseline): {P * baseline_discharge:.4f}")

}

    for j in range(num_practices):
        var_name = f"x_{i+1}_{j+1}"

print(f"  Required reduction: {required_val:.4f}")

}

# Required overall reduction fraction
P = 0.277

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Nutrient_Runoff_Reduction", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: fraction of each field treated by each practice (continuous, 0‑1)
x_A1 = pulp.LpVariable("x_A1", lowBound=0, upBound=1, cat="Continuous")
x_A2 = pulp.LpVariable("x_A2", lowBound=0, upBound=1, cat="Continuous")

x_B4 = pulp.LpVariable("x_B4", lowBound=0, upBound=1, cat="Continuous")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    cost_A1 * area_A * x_A1 + cost_A2 * area_A * x_A2 + cost_A3 * area_A * x_A3 + cost_A4 * area_A * x_A4 +
    cost_B1 * area_B * x_B1 + cost_B2 * area_B * x_B2 + cost_B3 * area_B * x_B3 + cost_B4 * area_B * x_B4 +
    cost_C1 * area_C * x_C1 + cost_C2 * area_C * x_C2 + cost_C3 * area_C * x_C3 + cost_C4 * area_C * x_C4 +

)

delivery_efficiency_min = 0.053   # minimum required weighted delivery efficiency

    rev_alpha * x_alpha +
    rev_beta  * x_beta  +
    rev_gamma * x_gamma +
    rev_delta * x_delta,
    "Total_Revenue"
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraints (named according to requirement IDs)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: Procedure 1 capacity
model += (
    time_alpha_proc1 * x_alpha +
    time_beta_proc1  * x_beta  +
    time_gamma_proc1 * x_gamma +
    time_delta_proc1 * x_delta
    <= capacity_proc1,
    "R1_proc1_capacity"
)

# R2: Procedure 2 capacity
model += (
    time_alpha_proc2 * x_alpha +
    time_beta_proc2  * x_beta  +
    time_gamma_proc2 * x_gamma +
    time_delta_proc2 * x_delta
    <= capacity_proc2,
    "R2_proc2_capacity"
)

# R3: Procedure 3 capacity
model += (
    time_alpha_proc3 * x_alpha +
    time_beta_proc3  * x_beta  +
    time_gamma_proc3 * x_gamma +
    time_delta_proc3 * x_delta
    <= capacity_proc3,
    "R3_proc3_capacity"
)

# R4: Procedure 4 capacity
model += (
    time_alpha_proc4 * x_alpha +
    time_beta_proc4  * x_beta  +
    time_gamma_proc4 * x_gamma +
    time_delta_proc4 * x_delta
    <= capacity_proc4,
    "R4_proc4_capacity"
)

# R5: Non‑negativity (already enforced by lowBound, but we add named constraints)
model += x_alpha >= 0, "R5_x_alpha_nonneg"
model += x_beta  >= 0, "R5_x_beta_nonneg"
model += x_gamma >= 0, "R5_x_gamma_nonneg"
model += x_delta >= 0, "R5_x_delta_nonneg"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    "epsilon": {"stage1": 1.509,  "stage2": 0.608, "stage3": 1.553, "stage4": 0.718, "stage5": 0.39 }
}

cap_stage4 = 175.889
cap_stage5 = 131.065

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("plan", pulp.LpMaximize)

# Decision variables (continuous, unrestricted bounds – non‑negativity added via constraints)
x_alpha   = pulp.LpVariable("x_alpha",   lowBound=None, cat="Continuous")
x_beta    = pulp.LpVariable("x_beta",    lowBound=None, cat="Continuous")
x_gamma   = pulp.LpVariable("x_gamma",   lowBound=None, cat="Continuous")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    rev_alpha   * x_alpha +
    rev_beta    * x_beta +
    rev_gamma   * x_gamma +
    rev_delta   * x_delta +
    rev_epsilon * x_epsilon,
    "R0_total_revenue"
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    cons["alpha"]["stage1"]   * x_alpha +
    cons["beta"]["stage1"]    * x_beta +
    cons["gamma"]["stage1"]   * x_gamma +
    cons["delta"]["stage1"]   * x_delta +

)

import pulp

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
N = 4  # number of centers
centers = list(range(1, N + 1))

# travel times (minutes) – symmetric
travel_time = {
    (1, 2): 197.5, (2, 1): 197.5,
    (1, 3): 251.0, (3, 1): 251.0,
    (1, 4): 216.8, (4, 1): 216.8,
    (2, 3): 98.0,  (3, 2): 98.0,
    (2, 4): 59.4,  (4, 2): 59.4,
    (3, 4): 41.2,  (4, 3): 41.2,
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("BloodBank_TSP", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
x = {}
for i in centers:
    for j in centers:
        if i != j:
            var_name = f"x_{i}{j}"
            x[(i, j)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")

# MTZ auxiliary position variables (only for nodes 2..N)
u = {}
for i in centers:
    if i != 1:  # node 1 is the depot, its position is fixed implicitly
        var_name = f"u_{i}"
        u[i] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=2, upBound=N, cat="Integer")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimize total travel time
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(travel_time[(i, j)] * x[(i, j)] for (i, j) in x), "objective"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements (constraints)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

# R1: each center has exactly one outgoing arc
for i in centers:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(i, j)] for j in centers if j != i) == 1,
        f"R1_out_{i}"
    )

# R2: each center has exactly one incoming arc
for i in centers:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(j, i)] for j in centers if j != i) == 1,
        f"R2_in_{i}"
    )

# R3: MTZ subtour elimination for i,j in {2,…,N}, i != j
for i in centers:
    for j in centers:
        if i != j and i != 1 and j != 1:
            model += (
                u[i] - u[j] + N * x[(i, j)] <= N - 1,
                f"R3_MTZ_{i}_{j}"
            )

# R4: bounds on auxiliary position variables (already set via lowBound/upBound,
#     but we also add explicit constraints to satisfy the “named constraint” rule)
for i in centers:
    if i != 1:
        model += (u[i] >= 2, f"R4_lower_{i}")
        model += (u[i] <= N, f"R4_upper_{i}")

# R5: binary nature of routing variables is already enforced by variable definition,
#     but we add explicit constraints for naming consistency
for (i, j) in x:
    model += (x[(i, j)] >= 0, f"R5_lower_{i}_{j}")
    model += (x[(i, j)] <= 1, f"R5_upper_{i}_{j}")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Total travel time: {pulp.value(model.objective)} minutes")
print("\nTour arcs (i -> j) where x_ij = 1:")
for (i, j), var in x.items():
    if var.varValue > 0.5:
        print(f"  {i} -> {j}")

print("\nMTZ positions (u_i):")
for i, var in u.items():
    print(f"  u_{i} = {var.varValue}")

import pulp

# -------------------------
# Data
# -------------------------
N = 4  # number of warehouses

# travel times (symmetric)
travel_time = {
    (1, 2): 124.4, (2, 1): 124.4,
    (1, 3): 102.2, (3, 1): 102.2,
    (1, 4): 132.5, (4, 1): 132.5,
    (2, 3): 112.0, (3, 2): 112.0,
    (2, 4): 11.7,  (4, 2): 11.7,
    (3, 4): 123.7, (4, 3): 123.7,
}

warehouses = [1, 2, 3, 4]

# -------------------------
# Model
# -------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Warehouse_Inspection_Tour", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    ((i, j) for i in warehouses for j in warehouses),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

u = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "u",
    (i for i in warehouses),
    lowBound=1,
    upBound=N,
    cat=pulp.LpInteger,
)

# -------------------------
# Objective
# -------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(travel_time[(i, j)] * x[(i, j)] for i in warehouses for j in warehouses if i != j), "Minimize_total_travel_time"

# -------------------------
# Requirements as constraints
# -------------------------

# R1: each warehouse departed exactly once
for i in warehouses:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(i, j)] for j in warehouses if j != i) == 1,
        f"R1_departure_{i}",
    )

# R2: each warehouse arrived exactly once
for i in warehouses:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(j, i)] for j in warehouses if j != i) == 1,
        f"R2_arrival_{i}",
    )

# R3: no self‑loops
for i in warehouses:
    model += (x[(i, i)] == 0, f"R3_no_self_{i}")

# R4: MTZ subtour elimination for i,j in {2,…,N}
for i in warehouses:
    for j in warehouses:
        if i != j and i != 1 and j != 1:
            model += (
                u[i] - u[j] + N * x[(i, j)] <= N - 1,
                f"R4_MTZ_{i}_{j}",
            )

# R5: tour start position fixed and bounds for u
model += (u[1] == 1, "R5_start_position")
for i in warehouses:
    if i != 1:
        model += (u[i] >= 2, f"R5_lower_bound_{i}")
        model += (u[i] <= N, f"R5_upper_bound_{i}")

# -------------------------
# Solve
# -------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# -------------------------
# Output
# -------------------------
print("Status:", pulp.LpStatus[model.status])
print("Total travel time:", pulp.value(model.objective))

print("\nTour arcs (i -> j) where x[i,j] = 1:")
for i in warehouses:
    for j in warehouses:
        if i != j and pulp.value(x[(i, j)]) > 0.5:
            print(f"  {i} -> {j}")

print("\nPosition of each warehouse in the tour (u[i]):")
for i in warehouses:
    print(f"  u[{i}] = {int(pulp.value(u[i]))}")

)   # x[p,t] = 1 if parcel p is placed in truck t

)   # y[t] = 1 if truck t is used

J = 22
# Capacity of each crate (kg)
C = 100

# Weights of the 22 archival boxes (kg) in the order given
w = [
    66,  # Alpha
    50,  # Beta
    42,  # Gamma
    56,  # Delta
    62,  # Epsilon
    62,  # Zeta
    37,  # Eta
    65,  # Theta
    36,  # Iota
    60,  # Kappa
    37,  # Lambda
    62,  # Mu
    58,  # Nu
    60,  # Xi
    41,  # Omicron
    59,  # Pi
    65,  # Rho
    51,  # Sigma
    38,  # Tau
    56,  # Upsilon
    46,  # Phi
    54   # Chi
]

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("archival_box_packing", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# x[i,j] = 1 if item i is placed in crate j, 0 otherwise
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    ((i, j) for i in range(I) for j in range(J)),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

# y[j] = 1 if crate j is used, 0 otherwise
y = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "y",
    (j for j in range(J)),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

# N = total number of crates used
N = pulp.LpVariable("N", lowBound=0, cat=pulp.LpInteger)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimize the total number of crates used
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += N, "objective_minimize_N"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements as named constraints
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: each item must be assigned to exactly one crate
for i in range(I):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[i, j] for j in range(J)) == 1,
        f"R1_item_{i}",
    )

# R2: if a crate is used, its total weight cannot exceed capacity
for j in range(J):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(w[i] * x[i, j] for i in range(I)) <= C * y[j],
        f"R2_capacity_{j}",
    )

# R3: total number of crates used equals the sum of y[j]
model += (
    N == pulp.lpSum(y[j] for j in range(J)),
    "R3_total",
)

# R4: variable type requirements are already enforced by variable definitions.
# (No extra constraints needed; binary/integer domains are set above.)

# R5: upper bound on the number of crates that can be opened
model += (
    pulp.lpSum(y[j] for j in range(J)) <= J,
    "R5_upper",
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
status = pulp.LpStatus[model.status]
print(f"Status: {status}")

if status == "Optimal":
    print(f"Minimum number of crates needed: {int(pulp.value(N))}\n")
    # Show which items go to which crate
    crate_contents = {j: [] for j in range(J) if pulp.value(y[j]) > 0.5}
    for i in range(I):
        for j in range(J):
            if pulp.value(x[i, j]) > 0.5:
                crate_contents[j].append(i)
                break
    for j, items in crate_contents.items():
        weight = sum(w[i] for i in items)
        print(f"Crate {j+1} (total weight {weight} kg): items {items}")
else:
    print("No optimal solution found.")

# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Water_Treatment_Procurement", pulp.LpMinimize)

# inventory[0] is the initial stock, inventory[1..12] are end‑of‑week stocks
inventory = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("inventory", range(0, 13),
                                  lowBound=0, upBound=storage_capacity,
                                  cat='Continuous')
shortage = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("shortage", T, lowBound=0, cat='Continuous')
received = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("received", T, lowBound=0, cat='Continuous')

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1: order bounds
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for t in T:
    model += order[t] >= order_min, f"R1_order_min_{t}"
    model += order[t] <= order_max, f"R1_order_max_{t}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R2: inventory bounds (explicitly named)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for t in T:
    model += inventory[t] >= 0, f"R2_inventory_nonneg_{t}"
    model += inventory[t] <= storage_capacity, f"R2_inventory_cap_{t}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R3: shortage bounds
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for t in T:
    model += shortage[t] >= 0, f"R3_shortage_nonneg_{t}"
    model += shortage[t] <= demand[t], f"R3_shortage_ub_{t}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R4: initial inventory
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += inventory[0] == initial_stock, "R4_initial_stock"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R5: received quantity captures the 2‑week delivery lag
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for t in T:
    if t <= lead_time:
        model += received[t] == 0, f"R5_received_zero_{t}"
    else:
        model += received[t] == order[t - lead_time], f"R5_received_link_{t}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

)

jobs = {

# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# Start time variables for every operation (patient, operation index)

duration = {}
equipment_of = {}
for p, ops in jobs.items():
    for idx, (eq, dur) in enumerate(ops):
        var_name = f"start_{p}_{idx}"
        start[(p, idx)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")
        duration[(p, idx)] = dur
        equipment_of[(p, idx)] = eq

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimise makespan
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += makespan, "R0_objective"

# R1 – Precedence constraints inside each patient test
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for p, ops in jobs.items():
    for idx in range(1, len(ops)):
        model += (
            start[(p, idx)] >= start[(p, idx - 1)] + duration[(p, idx - 1)],
            f"R1_precedence_{p}_{idx}",
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R2 – Equipment capacity (no overlap) using binary ordering variables
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# For each equipment collect the operations that need it
ops_by_eq = {eq: [] for eq in equipments}
for (p, idx), eq in equipment_of.items():
    ops_by_eq[eq].append((p, idx))

# Binary variables: y[(i,j)] = 1 if operation i finishes before operation j starts
y = {}
for eq, ops in ops_by_eq.items():
    # consider every unordered pair of operations on the same equipment
    for i in range(len(ops)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(ops)):
            op_i = ops[i]
            op_j = ops[j]
            var_name = f"y_{op_i[0]}_{op_i[1]}_before_{op_j[0]}_{op_j[1]}"
            y[(op_i, op_j)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")

            # i before j
            model += (
                start[op_i] + duration[op_i] <= start[op_j] + M * (1 - y[(op_i, op_j)]),
                f"R2_no_overlap_{eq}_{op_i[0]}_{op_i[1]}_before_{op_j[0]}_{op_j[1]}",
            )
            # j before i
            model += (
                start[op_j] + duration[op_j] <= start[op_i] + M * y[(op_i, op_j)],
                f"R2_no_overlap_{eq}_{op_j[0]}_{op_j[1]}_before_{op_i[0]}_{op_i[1]}",
            )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R3 – Makespan must be at least the completion time of every operation
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for (p, idx), st in start.items():
    model += (
        makespan >= st + duration[(p, idx)],
        f"R3_makespan_{p}_{idx}",
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R4 – Non‑negativity of start times (already enforced by lowBound, but named)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for (p, idx), st in start.items():
    model += (st >= 0, f"R4_nonneg_start_{p}_{idx}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output results
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Minimum makespan: {pulp.value(makespan)}\n")

    print(f"Patient {p} schedule:")

        s = pulp.value(start[(p, idx)])
        print(f"  Operation {idx+1} on Equipment {eq} (duration {dur}) starts at {s:.2f}")
    print()

Job‑shop model for the 6‑truck, 6‑dock unloading problem.
All requirements are expressed as named constraints:
R1 – truck‑internal sequencing,
R2 – dock capacity (no overlap),
R3 – makespan definition,
R4 – non‑negative start times.

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# trucks : list of (dock, processing_time) in the required order
trucks = {
    1: [(5, 2), (6, 1), (1, 1), (2, 2), (4, 6), (3, 8)],
    2: [(3, 4), (1, 3), (4, 9), (2, 9), (6, 2), (5, 9)],
    3: [(2, 8), (1, 7), (6, 5), (3, 1), (4, 10), (5, 3)],
    4: [(4, 2), (2, 10), (6, 7), (3, 6), (1, 4), (5, 9)],
    5: [(4, 9), (1, 8), (6, 9), (3, 7), (5, 8), (2, 5)],
    6: [(2, 8), (6, 2), (3, 2), (1, 8), (5, 7), (4, 10)],
}

# set of docks (1..6)
docks = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}

# big‑M – larger than any possible makespan
BIG_M = 300

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Logistics_JobShop", pulp.LpMinimize)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

start = {}
for i, ops in trucks.items():
    for k in range(len(ops)):
        var = pulp.LpVariable(f"start_T{i}_O{k}", lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")
        start[(i, k)] = var

# makespan

# binary ordering variables for every pair of operations that share a dock
y = {}
# collect operations per dock
ops_per_dock = {d: [] for d in docks}
for i, ops in trucks.items():
    for k, (d, p) in enumerate(ops):
        ops_per_dock[d].append((i, k))

for d, oplist in ops_per_dock.items():
    # create a binary for each unordered pair
    for idx1 in range(len(oplist)):
        i1, k1 = oplist[idx1]
        for idx2 in range(idx1 + 1, len(oplist)):
            i2, k2 = oplist[idx2]
            y[(i1, k1, i2, k2)] = pulp.LpVariable(
                f"y_T{i1}_O{k1}_T{i2}_O{k2}", cat="Binary"
            )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += Cmax, "R3_minimize_makespan"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraints
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1 – sequencing within each truck
for i, ops in trucks.items():
    for k in range(len(ops) - 1):
        p_k = ops[k][1]  # processing time of operation k
        model += (
            start[(i, k + 1)] >= start[(i, k)] + p_k,
            f"R1_sequence_T{i}_O{k}_to_O{k+1}",
        )

for d, oplist in ops_per_dock.items():
    for idx1 in range(len(oplist)):

        p1 = trucks[i1][k1][1]

            i2, k2 = oplist[idx2]
            p2 = trucks[i2][k2][1]

                f"R2_capacity_{i2}_{k2}_before_{i1}_{k1}",

for i, ops in trucks.items():
    for k, (_, p) in enumerate(ops):
        model += (
            Cmax >= start[(i, k)] + p,
            f"R3_makespan_T{i}_O{k}",
        )

# R4 – explicit non‑negative start times (named even though lowBound already set)
for i, ops in trucks.items():
    for k in range(len(ops)):
        model += (
            start[(i, k)] >= 0,
            f"R4_start_nonneg_T{i}_O{k}",
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# Output

    for k, (r, p) in enumerate(ops):
        var_name = f"s_{i}_{k}"
        start[(i, k)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimise makespan
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for i, ops in trucks.items():
    for k in range(len(ops) - 1):
        p_k = ops[k][1]                     # processing time of operation k
        model += (
            start[(i, k + 1)] >= start[(i, k)] + p_k,
            f"R1_Truck{i}_Op{k}_to_Op{k+1}"

    ("Epsilon", "Eta"):     (77,  4),
    ("Epsilon", "Theta"):   (33,  9)
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model

model = pulp.LpProblem("Power_Grid_Dispatch", pulp.LpMinimize)

for p in plants:
    for h in hubs:
        var_name = f"x_{p}_{h}"
        # Variables are continuous, lower bound 0 (non‑negative)

    line_data[(p, h)][1] * x[(p, h)] for p in plants for h in hubs
), "Total_Transmission_Cost"

for h in hubs:
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(p, h)] for p in plants) == dem[h],

]

    [9, 7, 10, 8, 7, 3, 10, 7],
    # Theta
    [3, 2, 10, 2, 3, 8, 5, 2],
]

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model

model = pulp.LpProblem("plan", pulp.LpMinimize)

x = {}

        # lowBound=0 is set, but we will also add an explicit non‑negativity constraint (R4)

            x[(p, d)] >= 0,
            f"R4_{p}_{d}",

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shipments S1..S10, each as a list of (hub, handling_time) in the required order
shipments = {
    "S1": [(10, 1), (6, 8), (7, 1), (4, 3), (8, 2), (2, 3), (5, 9), (9, 4), (1, 2), (3, 2)],
    "S2": [(7, 8), (4, 1), (1, 2), (2, 2), (9, 4), (10, 9), (8, 2), (5, 2), (3, 9), (6, 2)],
    "S3": [(10, 6), (2, 5), (1, 3), (9, 8), (3, 3), (4, 6), (7, 4), (5, 4), (6, 3), (8,10)],
    "S4": [(7, 7), (8, 1), (10,3), (1, 4), (5, 5), (2, 2), (9, 4), (6, 1), (4,10), (3, 8)],
    "S5": [(7,10), (10,1), (8, 1), (2, 2), (3,10), (1,10), (6, 8), (9, 8), (4, 4), (5, 8)],
    "S6": [(9, 7), (1, 6), (5, 4), (2, 4), (10,4), (7, 6), (3, 1), (4,10), (8, 2), (6, 1)],
    "S7": [(2, 8), (4, 8), (6, 8), (5, 4), (8,10), (1, 2), (9, 9), (10,9), (7, 3), (3, 2)],
    "S8": [(6, 4), (3, 4), (2, 5), (10,5), (9, 1), (4, 2), (7, 3), (1, 9), (5, 8), (8, 5)],
    "S9": [(3, 4), (2, 8), (9,10), (7, 8), (8, 2), (5, 6), (6, 7), (1, 9), (10,3), (4, 1)],
    "S10":[(7, 4), (3,10), (9, 8), (6, 1), (4, 7), (8,10), (2, 8), (5, 1), (1, 9), (10,6)]
}

# Create a flat list of operations
# op_id will be a tuple (shipment, index) where index starts at 0
ops = {}
for ship, seq in shipments.items():
    for idx, (hub, dur) in enumerate(seq):
        ops[(ship, idx)] = {"hub": hub, "dur": dur}

# Set of all hubs (1..10)
hubs = set(h for _, h in ops.values())

# Big M – larger than any possible makespan
M = sum(op["dur"] for op in ops.values()) + 1   # safe upper bound

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Logistics_JobShop", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: start time of each operation
start = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "Start",
    ((ship, idx) for (ship, idx) in ops),
    lowBound=0,
    cat="Continuous"
)

# Makespan variable
Cmax = pulp.LpVariable("Cmax", lowBound=0, cat="Continuous")

# Binary ordering variables for every pair of operations that share the same hub
order = {}
for hub in hubs:
    # collect all operations that need this hub
    ops_on_hub = [oid for oid, data in ops.items() if data["hub"] == hub]
    # create binary for each unordered pair
    for i in range(len(ops_on_hub)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(ops_on_hub)):
            o1 = ops_on_hub[i]
            o2 = ops_on_hub[j]
            var_name = f"Y_{o1[0]}_{o1[1]}_before_{o2[0]}_{o2[1]}"
            order[(o1, o2)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += Cmax, "R0_Objective_MinimizeMakespan"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraints
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1 – Precedence constraints inside each shipment (must follow given order)
for ship, seq in shipments.items():
    for idx in range(len(seq)-1):
        o_curr = (ship, idx)
        o_next = (ship, idx+1)
        model += (
            start[o_next] >= start[o_curr] + ops[o_curr]["dur"],
            f"R1_prec_{ship}_{idx}_to_{idx+1}"
        )

# R2 – Disjunctive (no‑overlap) constraints for operations sharing the same hub
for (o1, o2), y in order.items():
    p1 = ops[o1]["dur"]
    p2 = ops[o2]["dur"]
    # o1 before o2  (y = 1)  or o2 before o1 (y = 0)
    model += (
        start[o1] + p1 <= start[o2] + M * (1 - y),
        f"R2_no_overlap_{o1[0]}_{o1[1]}_before_{o2[0]}_{o2[1]}"
    )
    model += (
        start[o2] + p2 <= start[o1] + M * y,
        f"R2_no_overlap_{o2[0]}_{o2[1]}_before_{o1[0]}_{o1[1]}"
    )

# R3 – Makespan must be at least the completion time of every operation
for oid, data in ops.items():
    model += (
        Cmax >= start[oid] + data["dur"],
        f"R3_makespan_{oid[0]}_{oid[1]}"
    )

# R4 – Non‑negativity of start times (named even though bounds already exist)
for oid in ops:
    model += (
        start[oid] >= 0,
        f"R4_start_nonneg_{oid[0]}_{oid[1]}"
    )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model.solve(pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output (optional, for verification)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Minimum makespan (Cmax): {pulp.value(Cmax)}")
for oid in sorted(ops):
    print(f"Shipment {oid[0]} operation {oid[1]+1} (Hub {ops[oid]['hub']}, dur {ops[oid]['dur']}) starts at {pulp.value(start[oid]):.2f}")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fields are indexed 0..5 (corresponding to Field 1 … Field 6)
L = [0.748, 2.214, 1.861, 2.945, 1.397, 1.495]          # baseline loss per ha (kg N·ha⁻¹·yr⁻¹)
A = [97.452, 80.54, 262.008, 163.679, 215.692, 210.426] # cultivated area (ha)

# Practices are indexed 0..5 (Practice 1 … Practice 6)
E = [0.42, 0.88, 0.27, 0.70, 0.80, 0.45]               # fraction of loss reduced
C = [   # cost per ha for each field‑practice pair (currency/ha)
    [23.036, 155.38, 49.36, 51.031, 175.242, 72.426],
    [38.035, 181.101, 10.539, 173.097, 37.491, 34.699],
    [57.624, 43.154, 135.601, 14.898, 12.823, 160.097],
    [55.207, 71.517, 43.107, 19.956, 150.926, 109.956],
    [151.676, 100.487, 157.823, 107.515, 30.72, 105.729],
    [189.629, 18.239, 158.813, 174.726, 109.076, 97.028]
]

P = 0.682   # required proportion of baseline load to be reduced

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("NutrientRunoffAbatement", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables: proportion of each field's area on which each practice is applied
fields = range(len(L))          # 0..5
practices = range(len(E))       # 0..5
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts("x", (fields, practices), lowBound=0, upBound=1, cat='Continuous')

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1 – proportion limits 0 ≤ x[f,p] ≤ 1
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for f in fields:
    for p in practices:
        model += x[f][p] >= 0, f"R1_lower_f{f+1}_p{p+1}"
        model += x[f][p] <= 1, f"R1_upper_f{f+1}_p{p+1}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R2 – combined reduction on a field cannot exceed 100 % of its baseline loss
#       Σ_p E[p]·x[f,p] ≤ 1   for each field f
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
for f in fields:
    model += pulp.lpSum(E[p] * x[f][p] for p in practices) <= 1, f"R2_limit_f{f+1}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R3 – total nitrogen load reduction must be at least P of the baseline load
#       Σ_f L[f]·A[f]·Σ_p E[p]·x[f,p]  ≥  P·Σ_f L[f]·A[f]
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
baseline_total = sum(L[f] * A[f] for f in fields)
reduction_expr = pulp.lpSum(
    L[f] * A[f] * pulp.lpSum(E[p] * x[f][p] for p in practices)
    for f in fields
)
model += reduction_expr >= P * baseline_total, "R3_total_reduction"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective – minimise total implementation cost
#       Σ_f Σ_p C[f][p]·A[f]·x[f,p]
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
total_cost = pulp.lpSum(C[f][p] * A[f] * x[f][p] for f in fields for p in practices)
model += total_cost, "Objective_MinCost"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"Status: {pulp.LpStatus[model.status]}")
print(f"Total cost: {pulp.value(total_cost):.2f}")

print("\nPractice adoption proportions (field, practice, proportion):")
for f in fields:
    for p in practices:

print("\nAchieved reduction (kg N/yr):")
achieved = pulp.value(reduction_expr)

}

H_min   = 0.56   # minimum share for high‑priority projects A, C, D
env_max = 0.169  # maximum weighted environmental impact
eff_min = 0.094  # minimum weighted efficiency score
budget_total = 1.0  # total budget (fraction)

# Model

model = pulp.LpProblem("Infrastructure_Funding_Plan", pulp.LpMaximize)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(eff[i] * x[i] for i in eff), "Objective_Max_Efficiency"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    model += x[i] >= lb[i], f"R1_lb_{i}"
    model += x[i] <= ub[i], f"R1_ub_{i}"

# R2: total budget must be fully allocated
model += pulp.lpSum(x[i] for i in eff) == budget_total, "R2_budget"

# R3: high‑priority projects (A, C, D) receive at least H_min of the budget

import pulp

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
N = 11  # number of offices

# travel times (minutes) – only i<j are listed in the statement;
# we add the symmetric counterpart (j,i) with the same value.
travel = {
    (1, 2): 40.4, (1, 3): 77.4, (1, 4): 13.6, (1, 5): 135.1, (1, 6): 156.2,
    (1, 7): 201.8, (1, 8): 148.5, (1, 9): 191.4, (1,10): 111.0, (1,11): 179.6,
    (2, 3): 55.9, (2, 4): 32.4, (2, 5): 97.7, (2, 6): 132.8, (2, 7): 171.4,
    (2, 8): 110.4, (2, 9): 153.8, (2,10): 116.6, (2,11): 150.9,
    (3, 4): 78.5, (3, 5): 73.1, (3, 6): 79.2, (3, 7): 125.3, (3, 8): 87.4,
    (3, 9): 125.3, (3,10): 76.6, (3,11): 102.5,
    (4, 5): 129.8, (4, 6): 157.7, (4, 7): 200.6, (4, 8): 142.6,
    (4, 9): 186.0, (4,10): 120.7, (4,11): 179.0,
    (5, 6): 77.1, (5, 7): 85.2, (5, 8): 14.3, (5, 9): 56.3,
    (5,10): 140.6, (5,11): 72.8,
    (6, 7): 57.1, (6, 8): 83.5, (6, 9): 93.4, (6,10): 99.4,
    (6,11): 33.5,
    (7, 8): 81.7, (7, 9): 62.0, (7,10): 156.5, (7,11): 24.2,
    (8, 9): 43.7, (8,10): 153.7, (8,11): 73.2,
    (9,10): 182.3, (9,11): 67.7,
    (10,11): 132.8,
}
# make the matrix symmetric
for (i, j), v in list(travel.items()):
    travel[(j, i)] = v

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Office_Tour", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# x[i,j] = 1 if we travel directly from i to j
x = {}
for i in range(1, N + 1):
    for j in range(1, N + 1):
        if i != j:
            var_name = f"x_{i}_{j}"
            x[(i, j)] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, cat="Binary")

# u[i] = position of office i in the tour (MTZ formulation)
# defined only for i = 2 .. N (office 1 is the implicit depot)
u = {}
for i in range(2, N + 1):
    var_name = f"u_{i}"
    u[i] = pulp.LpVariable(var_name, lowBound=2, upBound=N, cat="Integer")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Objective: minimise total travel time
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(travel[(i, j)] * x[(i, j)] for (i, j) in x), "Total_Travel_Time"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Requirements implementation
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# R1 – each office must be left exactly once
for i in range(1, N + 1):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(i, j)] for j in range(1, N + 1) if j != i) == 1,
        f"R1_leave_{i}",
    )

# R2 – each office must be entered exactly once
for j in range(1, N + 1):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[(i, j)] for i in range(1, N + 1) if i != j) == 1,
        f"R2_enter_{j}",
    )

# R3 – MTZ subtour elimination for i,j in {2,…,N}, i != j
for i in range(2, N + 1):
    for j in range(2, N + 1):
        if i != j:
            model += (
                u[i] - u[j] + N * x[(i, j)] <= N - 1,
                f"R3_mtz_{i}_{j}",
            )

# R3 – bounds on the MTZ ordering variables (still part of the same requirement)
for i in range(2, N + 1):
    model += (u[i] >= 2, f"R3_u_lower_{i}")
    model += (u[i] <= N, f"R3_u_upper_{i}")

# R4 – tour must start and end at the same office
# (implicit from the flow constraints; no extra constraint needed)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print("Status:", pulp.LpStatus[model.status])
print("Total travel time (minutes):", pulp.value(model.objective))

# Reconstruct the tour order
tour = []
# start from office 1 (arbitrary depot)
current = 1
visited = set()
while True:
    visited.add(current)
    # find the next office
    next_office = None
    for j in range(1, N + 1):
        if current != j and pulp.value(x[(current, j)]) > 0.5:
            next_office = j
            break
    if next_office is None or next_office == 1:
        break
    tour.append((current, next_office))
    current = next_office
    if len(visited) == N:
        # close the tour back to the depot
        tour.append((current, 1))
        break

print("Tour (i -> j):")
for i, j in tour:
    print(f"  {i} -> {j}")

}

)

    x_Alpha_East + x_Beta_East + x_Gamma_East + x_Delta_East == 107,

)

)

model += x_Alpha_North >= 0, "R9_x_Alpha_North"
